facts.business: The company ceased operations in 2012-13 due to commercial unviability and had no business operations during the year; it is evaluating options including starting a new line of business.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The company discontinued operations, incurred a net loss of Rs. 300.20 lakh, accumulated losses of Rs. 11,287.28 lakh, and negative net worth. Parent company Network 18 Media & Investments Limited provided a support letter for financial support. Opinion not modified.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to discontinued operations, accumulated losses, and negative net worth; contingent liabilities in respect of Income tax and Sales tax matters
facts.related_party_note: Network 18 Media & Investments Limited, the Parent Company, has given a support letter to extend financial support for the foreseeable future.
